title: Dedup a sorted array in place
prompt:
Given an array **sorted ascending**, remove duplicates in place so each value appears once; return the new logical length. Elements beyond the returned length are ignored by the grader. Implement `process(int[] arr)` (return 0 for empty).

Example: `{1,1,2,3,3}` → returns `3`, first three cells `{1,2,3}`.

tests.name: compacted length and cells
tests.hint: Write-index: w starts at 1; append arr[i] only when it differs from arr[w-1].
